thread:
marta: quick heads-up 5 autoscaler observer prototype ready for feedback. goal: run policy changes against a sandboxed model without touching allocator or metrics backends.
kevin: nice. does it replay real traces or synth workloads?
marta: both. the plan is: 1) replay historical tenant traces, 2) run synthetic stress patterns (bursts, ramps, diurnal), 3) run lightweight fuzzing.
sriniv: important: simulator should model provisioning delays (node boot, driver init) and GPU warmup. otherwise scale-up looks instantaneous.
julia: +1. also need to model eviction/preemption latency for preemptible nodes. those affect P95/P99.
kevin: how will this integrate with PR checks? we don't want flaky failures for minor refactors.
ops-bot: suggestion: run a deterministic baseline scenario in CI (seeded), produce a compact summary artifact with numeric diffs. only fail PRs on safety thresholds.
marta: exactly. CI run uses deterministic seed and a canonical tenant-mix. nightly runs do stochastic fuzzing for exploratory discovery.
infra-bot: infra note: telemetry snapshots are large. propose we ingest pre-aggregated windows (1m bins) instead of raw events for simulation input. storage cost: small.
sriniv: simulator internals: clone intent graph + tenant contracts into memory, run a mock allocator that only accounts for capacity (no writes), and compute time-stepped state transitions.
julia: can we reuse parts of the existing admission logic? effort to port is high but gives fidelity. maybe implement an adapter layer to run live code in read-only mode.
marta: adapter idea is good. we can run the control logic with a stubbed allocator API that returns hypothetical placements.
kevin: payload sketch for a simulate call:
```
POST /v1/autoscale/simulate
{"policy": "refs/changes/policy-123.patch", "trace_id": "burst-2026-04-03", "duration": "45m", "options": {"include_commits": true, "seed": 42}}
```
response example:
```
{
  "timeline": [ {"t":0, "nodes": 2, "p95_ms": 75}, {"t":5, "nodes": 4, "p95_ms": 110}, {"t":10, "nodes": 8, "p95_ms": 220} ],
  "alerts": ["reservation_violation: tenant-acme exceeded committed GPUs at t=10"],
  "meta": {"oscillation_index": "0.23", "seed": 42}
}
```
kevin: small ask: include per-tenant delta so product teams can see who loses capacity in the sim.
sriniv: perf plan: run simulation jobs as short-lived k8s jobs. single-job memory needs are moderate. to scan N policies for a rollout, fan-out jobs and aggregate results.
julia: UX: CLI that runs local simulate with a smallish synthetic trace for devs is helpful. plus GH action that posts a summary comment to the PR.
ops-bot: rollout proposal: (A) implement local CLI + API MVP, (B) CI integration and action, (C) nightly stochastic fuzz runs, (D) Console view showing a compact "policy impact" diff.
marta: policy language change proposal: add "stability_hysteresis" and "min_nodes_hold" so the simulator and runtime share explicit knobs.
kevin: how do we ensure the simulator respects reserved capacity/contracts? need to load committed allocations and tie-break rules.
sriniv: load reservation table read-only. enforce quotas in the sim and emit violations in alerts. don't mutate DB.
julia: test matrix for PRs: small deterministic trace, reserved-tenant scenario, burst-mix, slow-provision scenario. keep runtime tests minimal to avoid CI slowdowns.
marta: question: stochastic nightly runs should have an anomaly detector that surfaces new oscillation patterns. ops-bot: we can compute an "instability score" and file tickets automatically when a threshold is crossed.
kevin: do we want the simulator to propose mitigations? like suggest a larger cooldown or smaller step-scaling.
marta: MVP won't auto-suggest, but will provide metrics (oscillation index, max tail latency, reservation breaches) for humans to act on. longer term we can add suggestion heuristics.
infra-bot: created infra ticket INFRA-9999 to provision simulation-queue and snapshot pipeline. estimate: 2-3 sprint infra work.
sriniv: implementation note: separate deterministic-mode (repro for CI) and explore-mode (Monte Carlo) for nightly. store seeds with results.
julia: we should also surface cost delta estimates in the sim so PMs can reason about unit economics. approximate GPU-hour cost is fine.
marta: next steps: I'll open a short design doc and link a toy repo with the CLI. owners: marta, kevin, sriniv. will schedule a 30m sync after the doc is up. :calendar: :thumbsup:
ops-bot: acked. will add rollout checklist to the infra ticket.
